profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Namely
profile.summary: Front end engineer with product (SAAS) and digital agency experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently a front end engineer building features for Namely's Human Capital Management web application using React/Redux/CSS Modules. Also part of the core front end team that sets coding standards and builds shared components used by the entire engineering organization.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Built customer facing solutions on eCommerce websites for over 15 clients, primarily using the Magento platform. 
- Became a Magento certified front end developer within six months of employment. 
- Was the lead front end developer for the website of a premium haircare brand for close to 2 years. Key initiatives for this site included a responsive redesign that significantly increased mobile engagement, an interactive quiz that recommended hair products (taken over 40,000 times in the first 3 months with a 90% completion rate), a custom site search, and a micro-site educating users about hair health. 
- Participated in an Agile workflow that included requirements gathering, estimations, sprint planning, daily progress updates, documentation, time logging, and retrospectives.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Assisted in the front-end development of responsive mobile and tablet solutions for financial services clients. Additionally, worked with a cross disciplinary team of other interns to plan and present our ideas for a crowd-sourced mobile application that would supplement a public transportation system.

positions.title: Visual Effects Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted the students in the 'Technical Concepts of Visual Effects' course with any problems they encountered.

positions.title: Farley Hall Mail Clerk
positions.description: Organized and distributed mail for Farley Hall at Notre Dame.
